assignment.title: Practical assignment — Discover polygon angle sums
assignment.description:
Draw two different triangles and two different convex quadrilaterals. Measure each interior angle with a protractor. Record the sums. For one triangle and one quadrilateral extend a side at each vertex consistently to mark exterior angles; measure and record their sums. Explain the relationship between an interior angle and its adjacent exterior angle. Include labelled working or photos.

Upload clear photographs or a PDF of your own work. Your teacher will assess the work.
assignment.solution: Teacher rubric (100): accurate labelled figures 20; measurements and reasonable protractor accuracy 25; interior sums near 180°/360° with explanation 20; exterior sums near 360° for both shapes 20; explanation that each interior/exterior pair totals 180°, 15. Allow small measurement error; evaluate reasoning.
